22	- Bumped go-git with improved large packfile memory efficiency ([#731](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/731))

55	## [0.5.0] - 2026-03-06
56	
57	### Added
58	
59	- External agent plugin system with lazy discovery, timeout protection, feature-flag gating, and stdin/stdout caps ([docs](https://docs.entire.io/cli/external-agents), [#604](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/604))

104	## [0.4.9] - 2026-03-02
105	
106	### Added
107	
108	- Factory AI Droid agent integration with full checkpoint, resume, rewind, and session transcript support ([#435](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/435), [#552](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/552))

The main gaps in the Codex integration due to missing hooks:

**Missing hooks (Codex doesn't expose these):**
- **`session-end`** — no explicit session end signal, only `stop` (turn end)
- **`pre-task` / `post-task`** — no subagent tracking, so spawned agent files/tokens won't be captured in checkpoints

**Missing agent capabilities:**
- **TranscriptPreparer** — no async transcript flush/sync before reads
- **TextGenerator** — can't auto-generate trail titles/summaries via Codex CLI
- **SubagentAwareExtractor** — tied to the missing `pre-task`/`post-task` hooks

The integration is marked as `IsPreview()` reflecting these limitations. The core flow (checkpoints, rewind, resume, token tracking) works, but subagent-aware features and session lifecycle precision are limited by what Codex exposes.
